exposure: Presence of meconium in amniotic fluid
Prolonged latent and active phases of labour
Number of misoprostol doses for successful induction
cohort: 348 women undergoing induction of labor at term at an obstetric unit of Eastern Nepal, from June 2006 to July 2007
finding: Bishop's score ≤5 at induction, birth weight >4 kg, prolonged latent and active phases of labor were significantly associated with increased risk of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Bishop's score ≤5 at induction, birth weight >4 kg, prolonged latent and active phases of labor were significantly associated with increased risk of cesarean delivery.
